[USER] User asked for tips to ensure cauliflower rice and pizza crust turn out delicious and not mushy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using fresh, firm cauliflower heads that are not too soft or starting to brown for cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised cutting cauliflower into small florets and avoiding the stems to prevent bitterness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended not over-blending cauliflower to avoid mushiness, pulsing until it resembles rice, and cooking for 2-3 minutes until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested draining excess water after cooking cauliflower rice to prevent mushiness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended squeezing out excess moisture from grated cauliflower for pizza crust using cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested adding dry ingredients (such as almond flour or coconut flour) to help absorb moisture in pizza crust.
